newsitem.title: CANADA: Epic Energy names TCPL boss as its chairman.
newsitem.headline: Epic Energy names TCPL boss as its chairman.

text.p: Epic Energy Inc said on Friday that it named a number of high-profile executives to its board of directors, including TransCanada PipeLines Ltd chairman Gerald Maier.
Epic said it appointed Maier as its chairman, replacing Robert O. Anderson, who will become Epic's chairman emeritus.

Other appointees to EPIC's board included Bohdan Hawrylyshyn, director of the International Academy of the Environment (Geneva), John Beddome, Chairman of IPSCO Inc, and Brooke Wade, Chairman of Acetex Corp and former chief executive of Methanex Corp.
Epic President and Chief Executive Ronald Cormick said the company would also announce key additions to its management group soon. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
